data: Which of the lines in the top plot represents the 'Random' method?

The top plot shows Kendall's τ correlation against the size of the subspace. The legend indicates three methods: Ultradense, PCA, and Random. The yellow line represents the Random method because it is the lowest line across all sizes of the subspace. Therefore, the yellow line corresponds to the 'Random' method.
